Trajx WASM - Motion-Centric API Demo

This demo showcases the new Motion-Centric API for robot motion planning.

Loading WASM module...

Console Log

WasmMotion API

1. Simple Point-to-Point Motion

// Simple motion to target joints const result = WasmMotion.to([1.0, 0.5, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 0]) .run(robot);

2. Motion with Constraints

// Motion with speed and smoothness const result = WasmMotion.to(goal) .speed(0.5) .smooth() .run(robot);

3. Linear Motion

// Linear Cartesian interpolation const result = WasmMotion.to(goal) .linear() .safe() .run(robot);

4. Precision Mode

// Slow + very smooth = precision const result = WasmMotion.to(goal) .precise() // = .slow().verySmooth() .run(robot);

WasmPath & WasmSequence API

5. Multi-Waypoint Path

// Path through multiple waypoints const path = WasmPath.through(waypoints, dof) .linear() .speed(0.8) .run(robot);

6. Motion Sequence

// Chain multiple motions const seq = WasmSequence.start(motion1) .then(motion2) .then(motion3) .run(robot);

7. Trajectory Inspection

// Inspect trajectory result result.numPoints result.trajectoryDuration result.pathLength result.getPositionsAt(index)

Collision-Aware Motion (NEW!)

Use runWithCollision() to enable BiRRT planning with collision checking. When .safe() is set, the planner automatically avoids obstacles.

8. Motion with Collision Avoidance

// Collision-aware motion planning const motion = WasmMotion.to(goal) .safe() // Enable collision avoidance .speed(0.8); // Define collision checker (returns true if VALID - no collision) const collisionChecker = (joints) => { // Your collision detection logic here return true; // Valid (no collision) }; const result = motion.runWithCollision(robot, collisionChecker);

9. Path with Collision Avoidance

// Path through waypoints with collision checking const path = WasmPath.through(waypoints, dof) .safe() .linear(); const result = path.runWithCollision(robot, collisionChecker);

10. Sequence with Collision Avoidance

// Chain motions with collision checking const seq = WasmSequence.start(motion1.safe()) .then(motion2.safe()) .then(motion3.safe()); const result = seq.runWithCollision(robot, collisionChecker);

Integration Test: Pick and Place

// Simulated pick and place sequence const pickApproach = WasmMotion.to(pickApproachPos).fast(); const pick = WasmMotion.to(pickPos).linear().slow(); const pickRetreat = WasmMotion.to(pickRetreatPos).linear(); const placeApproach = WasmMotion.to(placeApproachPos).fast(); const place = WasmMotion.to(placePos).linear().slow(); const placeRetreat = WasmMotion.to(placeRetreatPos).linear(); const result = WasmSequence.start(pickApproach) .then(pick) .then(pickRetreat) .then(placeApproach) .then(place) .then(placeRetreat) .run(robot);
